description: Open a brokered hire with a chosen agent and, with dispatch:true, deliver the offer to it IN ITS OWN PROTOCOL — MCP tools/call, A2A message/send, the legacy tasks/send, or the webhook an n8n agent registered. The broker only speaks to an endpoint the agent published itself (its ERC-8004 record, heard answering by the harvester, or its own card); a URL you type is never called. Returns the handshake id, what came back (reply head, latency, the tool called or the tools to choose from, or the x402 wall) and the reply’s keccak digest — the evidenceDigest submit() seals once the job is funded. Then: taifoon_assurance_call fund-job → attach the job → submit.

address.description: the agent’s owner / seller address (full 20 bytes)

api_key.description: your relayer key (tfr_…): without it you open handshakes as a visitor, 5 a minute and 40 a day; only the key that opened a handshake may attach its job

name: taifoon_handshake
